collectible.title: Devil's Trident
collectible.subtitle: Mwahahaha!
collectible.text:
A weapon truly fit for a demon queen, or for eating giant pancakes. Picking it up, you can faintly hear villainous laughter, and maybe a cough or two.
(Unlocks Shamiko's "Demon of Fantasia costume!)
collectible.unlock: Give Shamiko the demonic experience she needs by having her learn from the most horned, demonic, and villainous opponents around.
